headlines.title: If You Invested $300,000 in Coca-Cola, PepsiCo and Keurig Dr Pepper, Here’s What They’d Pay
headlines.summary: Three soda giants promise retirees steady checks, but one has frozen its payout, another has the thinnest cushion, and all three share the same weak spot. Which one carries the biggest share of the income, and what could knock them all down together?

headlines.title: PepsiCo Extends KFC Beverage Partnership Across Eight International Markets
headlines.summary: PepsiCo (NASDAQ:PEP) has renewed its beverage supply agreement with KFC across eight international markets, extending a longstanding commercial relationship between the food and beverage companies. The agreement covers Australia, India, the United Kingdom, Spain, Germany, France, the Netherlands and Belgium.

headlines.title: PepsiCo Secures Renewal Across Select KFC International Markets
headlines.summary: PepsiCo (NASDAQ: PEP) has been selected as the continued beverage partner of choice for KFC locations across Australia, India, UK, Spain, Germany, France, the Netherlands, and Belgium. This renewal builds on a decades-long global partnership with KFC across the Middle East, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America and other markets already serving PepsiCo brands and products.

headlines.title: PepsiCo Lowers 2026 EPS Outlook as North America Pressures Margins
headlines.summary: PEP cuts its 2026 EPS growth outlook as North American margin pressures persist, while strong international growth and productivity savings offer support.

headlines.title: PepsiCo Jumps 15.1% in a Month as Investors Weigh What Comes Next
headlines.summary: PEP shares surge 15.1% in a month as strong international growth and a valuation discount face North American margin pressures and a weaker earnings outlook.

description: PepsiCo, Inc. engages in the manufacture, marketing, distribution, and sale of various beverages and convenient foods worldwide. The company operates through six segments: PepsiCo Foods North America; PepsiCo Beverages North America; International Beverages Franchise; Europe, Middle East and Africa; Latin America Foods; and Asia Pacific Foods. It offers cereals, chips, dips, granola bars, oatmeal, pasta, rice, and syrups and mixes; refrigerated dips and spreads; beverage concentrates, fountain syrups, and finished goods; and ready-to-drink tea and coffee products. The company also provides SodaStream sparkling water makers and related products, as well as various dairy products under the Agusha, Chudo, and Domik v Derevne brands. It serves wholesale and other distributors, foodservice customers, grocery stores, drug stores, convenience stores, discount/dollar stores, mass merchandisers, membership stores, hard discounters, e-commerce retailers and authorized independent bottlers, and others through a network of direct-store-delivery, customer warehouse, and distributor networks, as well as directly to consumers through e-commerce platforms and retailers. PepsiCo, Inc. was founded in 1898 and is based in Purchase, New York.
